question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a32dacde87632a4a3622aa97880af40fcb873a01d1ad10e7323dac5ddab331.png]
solution:

The central figure moves 90 degree in clockwise direction and the alphabets also moves in the clockwise direction by in substituting to the very next alphabet of the English alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fdd3dc9d2065a5464d59d42dfe100e166587a800ad81031fe1cb972607c4c4f.png]
